name: TR_V0_L2_OBSERVATION_CONTRACT
golden_question: Among companies with a real operating transition, what independently observable PIT state distinguishes a merely real transition from an economically selectable, not-yet-recognized transition?

selection_vs_timing.note: Recognition gap is selection information first; timing only if selection bridge later passes economic test.

reality_observation_contract.pit_law: available_at <= decision_as_of; Original-filing / admitted S0 law; no future vintage

derived_observation_levels.law: same period; positive revenue; else UNOBSERVED→ABSTAIN
same period; positive revenue; else UNOBSERVED→ABSTAIN

reality_true_definition_form.description: Reality=true when at least one domain-limited transition observation is APPLICABLE_OBSERVED and exhibits a preregistered non-null transition state under frozen operator family; exact materiality cuts deferred to L3/L4 and MUST NOT be fit on FTK residual outcomes.
forbidden: define Reality as FTK selected-set membership
threshold search on failed FTK economic dates

as_of_lag_law: OBSERVED_CONSENSUS and INFERRED_MARKET_IMPLIED must remain explicitly labeled
inferred must never masquerade as observed consensus
recognition_observation_contract.parked_reason: Keep first recognition surface low-DOF; parked measures may enter only via new freeze slice, not free feature search.

source_bind.adapter_behavior: research/alpha_pit_v1/adapters/ciq_cycle_v1.py returns MISSING_SOURCE sentinel rows when expectations source pair absent

recognition_gap_contract.definition_form: Given Reality=true, contemporaneous recognition has not incorporated the transition relative to a preregistered mapping from Reality observation to expected recognition response.

operator_family_v0.form: Reality_true AND (EPS_FY1_REVISION_30D is null OR not material_up_revision under later L3/L4 frozen cut)
operator_family_v0.forbidden: fit cut on FTK residual outcomes or returns

operator_family_v0.form: Reality_true AND EPS_FY1 present but recognition state classified not-yet-updated under later frozen rule

recognition_gap_contract.already_recognized_form: Reality_true AND material concurrent upward revision / updated consensus under same frozen cuts

selection_contrast.later_test: D6 selection enrichment B vs A under separate preregistered wager law

forbidden_definitions: gap from FTK K/H policy residuals
gap from failed FTK decision-date payoffs

family_data_contract.allowed_observation_surface_note: Reality uses admitted S0/FTK transition primitives as observation only; not CRV1 risk-set authority.

falsifiers_still_live.F1: Recognition cannot be defined independently of future returns -> KILL
falsifiers_still_live.F2: Recognition merely re-encodes Reality/FTK transition -> KILL
falsifiers_still_live.F4: Defined from failed FTK dates/payoffs -> KILL
falsifiers_still_live.F5: Requires H/K/threshold from economic residuals -> KILL
